question_stem:
The variation with potential difference (p.d.) V of current I for a semiconductor diode is shown in
Fig. 5.1.
question_stem_latex:
The variation with potential difference (p.d.) V of current I for a semiconductor diode is shown in
Fig. 5.1.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
Use Fig. 5.1 to describe the variation of the resistance of the diode between
V = -0.5 V and V = 0.8 V.
parts.question_text_latex:
Use Fig. 5.1 to describe the variation of the resistance of the diode between
$V = -0.5 V and V = 0.8 V.$

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
On Fig. 5.2, sketch the variation with p.d. V of current I for a filament lamp. Numerical values
are not required.
parts.question_text_latex:
On Fig. 5.2, sketch the variation with p.d. V of current I for a filament lamp. Numerical values
are not required.

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
Fig. 5.3 shows a power supply of electromotive force (e.m.f.) 12 V and internal resistance
0.50 Ω connected to a filament lamp and switch.
The filament lamp has a power of 36 W when the p.d. across it is 12 V.
parts.question_text_latex:
Fig. 5.3 shows a power supply of electromotive force (e.m.f.) 12 V and internal resistance
0.50 $\Omega$ connected to a filament lamp and switch.
The filament lamp has a power of 36 W when the p.d. across it is 12 V.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the resistance of the lamp when the p.d. across it is 12 V.
resistance = Ω
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the resistance of the lamp when the p.d. across it is 12 V.
$resistance = \Omega $

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.question_text:
The switch is closed and the current in the lamp is 2.8 A. Calculate the resistance of the
lamp.
resistance = Ω
parts.question_text_latex:
The switch is closed and the current in the lamp is 2.8 A. Calculate the resistance of the
lamp.
$resistance = \Omega $

parts.label: (d)
parts.question_text:
Explain how the two values of resistance calculated in (c) provide evidence for the shape of
the sketch you have drawn in (b).
parts.question_text_latex:
Explain how the two values of resistance calculated in (c) provide evidence for the shape of
the sketch you have drawn in (b).
